title: Read one Client's provider-free core record and local revision with explicit offline truth

requirements.invariant: One Client core read binds an exact AccountID and stable ClientID. Names, paths and provider locators cannot define, repair, rebind or authorize identity.

The product specification requires exact opaque ClientID, owning AccountID, current ClientDisplayName, active-or-archived lifecycle and createdAt/updatedAt audit fields. This slice reuses, rather than redefines, the verified ClientSummary dependency's finite and createdAt-no-later-than-updatedAt validation, including valid equal timestamps. A nonblank padded name is preserved exactly; this slice invents no trimming or audit provenance.

An archived Client remains a found historical/current identity record. This read defines no selection visibility, cascade, restore, hard delete, merge, reassignment or frozen-history rewrite behavior.

The row carries the exact locally observed ExpectedClientRevision required by verified rename/archive commands. It is conflict-precondition evidence, distinct from LocalDataVersion and updatedAt, and is never current authoritative server revision under incomplete, partial or stale evidence.

At-most-one exact-request local evidence preserves LocalDataVersion, finite as-of, readiness and completeness. Only complete ready zero-row evidence is authoritative absence; incomplete, partial and stale found/empty states remain explicit.

requirements.section: Clients, Projects, notes, preferences, and reference data
requirements.invariant: One backend-neutral query port streams only exact request updates. Waiting, unavailable, retryable and required-update remain explicit; unavailable is non-enumerating, cache cannot rebind, and failure/cancellation cannot yield false detail or absence.

This is not a Client workspace or CRM model. It contains no Projects/counts, Transfer eligibility, contacts, communication, billing, history, financial, media or mutation evidence; O-025 merge/reassignment remains open.

This Phase 1 boundary is executable only with deterministic provider-free synthetic evidence while Firebase remains unchanged. It defines no persistence, authorization, schema/RLS/Sync/Auth/provider, app/MCP, migration, hosted resource, release or production behavior.

items: ClientCoreDetailsRequest binds exact AccountID and ClientID to a deterministic versioned fingerprint and revalidates after decode.
ClientCoreDetailsSnapshot reuses ClientSummary and carries exact locallyObservedRevision: ExpectedClientRevision without claiming server-current authority.
ClientCoreDetailsLocalSnapshot enforces zero-or-one exact row, exact visible count, explicit readiness/completeness/version/as-of and ready-complete-zero-only authoritative absence.
ClientCoreDetailsUpdate, bounded failure and ClientCoreDetailsQuerying form the sole narrow provider-free port.

postgresSchema.notApplicable: No Client table, lifecycle/revision column, constraint, index, view, function, trigger or migration is created.

serverHandlers.notApplicable: No authoritative get-Client handler, capability derivation, mutation, audit event or reconciliation exists.

dataApiGrants.notApplicable: No Data API relation/function or grant is added.

rlsPolicies.notApplicable: Typed Client evidence is not authorization; no membership or cross-account database policy/test exists.

syncStreams.notApplicable: No PowerSync Stream, local Client table, subscription or upload connector exists.

items: Canonical Codable request/row/snapshot/update evidence preserves exact ClientSummary, local revision and local truth across structured restart.
At-most-one cardinality and exact binding prevent hidden rows or incomplete empty cache from becoming authority.
A deterministic reference port proves exact streaming/failure/cancellation, not physical persistence, authorization or authenticated synchronization.

storageMedia.notApplicable: No attachment, image, locator, upload, cache, retention or deletion behavior exists.

appMcp.notApplicable: No Client view/list/navigation/action or MCP contract/handler is added.

migrationReconciliation.notApplicable: No Firebase Client DTO, clientName copy, document path, export row or migration disposition is decoded.

observabilityRunbooks.notApplicable: Stable local failures are values only; no telemetry, alert or runbook is introduced.

items: Implementation remains inside provider-free LedgerTargetCore and tests without changing either application project.
The slice cannot authorize, persist, synchronize, mutate or present a complete Client workspace; deploy, migrate, release or cut over.
O-025 and A-003/A-004/A-007/A-015/A-016 remain outside; physical and hosted verification stay gated.

verification.expected: Active/archived Clients preserve exact IDs, padded/interior-spaced name, lifecycle, finite ordered/equal audit times and revision 0/max; AccountID and ClientID independently alter fingerprint.
Ready found/absent, incomplete found/empty, partial found/empty and stale found/empty restart byte-identically; archived remains found and non-ready revision remains non-authoritative.

Malformed or missing encoding, request/fingerprint/row rebinding (including same display name with the wrong ClientID), invalid ClientSummary name/nonfinite or reversed audit/lifecycle evidence, missing or negative revision, both identical and distinct two-row evidence, negative and mismatched visible counts, and both partial+complete and stale+complete evidence fail atomically. Every failure is asserted against its literal unique bounded provider-neutral diagnostic code and diagnostics contain no Client name or ID. Separately valid later name, timestamp, lifecycle or revision snapshots are accepted.

Waiting accepts exactly notRequested/loading/blocked and rejects exactly ready/partial/stale; unavailable is non-enumerating and carries no cache; retryable and requiredUpdate remain distinct and exact-request cached evidence cannot upgrade completeness, revision authority or authorization.

Reference port validates before yield; a deliberately raw consumer with no validation proves mismatched updates are refused; upstream failure and cancellation produce no false detail/absence; exact encoded-key allowlists for every new Codable value prove the frozen exclusions.
